methods: Only after two original process FIT streams verified byte-normalized identical: count source action, goal reward, terminal event, signed Manhattan-distance progress by family/action; action 0 and 1 should have no immediate positional progress because turns only rotate.

Load original pinned native Yggdrasil GridColony source unchanged; feed all 6114 saved original FIT action/after/reward events in identical recorded order, record native choice and per-action scores BEFORE every update.
Require final checkpoint sha256 EXACT equality to K4U original native_FIT_checks.yggdrasil_checkpoint_sha256 before trusting native policy replay. If mismatched STOP and mark unqualified.

Posthoc diagnostic scoring on original FIT public-state input only: compare native full-signal action argmax with counterfactual scoring views removing nonlinear ring term, reading fast-only/slow-only individual cells from frozen model. Do NOT retrain or use DEV.

Inspect whether right-turn action1 has positive direct reward examples, native action1 choice count, and full-model right-vs-best-other rank margins; do not assert causality without prospective intervention.
Preserve all original negative DEV scores as read-only context, never read original DEV or CHECK rows or fit from them.
